snippet.title: RED CARNATION || A game that honors the Art that survived Salazar, in Portugal.
snippet.description:
|| Still in Development ||

Find us in itchio.

Red Carnation is a point and click, 2D, Narrative driven puzzle game.

 It takes place in the 1970's during the Salazar Dictatorship. In this story, we follow a young man whose poet mother has suddenly vanished. 

 Upon finding your mother's diary, you begin to uncover the secret life she lived. 

 It's up to you to find the hidden messages in her poems, and to link it with the censored media in the environment, in order to discover the truth. 

 However, there are some unexpected forces at play, as you find yourself uncover the secrets of something far larger than you could have ever expected...
